description: Add the user's own list of sounds to a kit (an app's or a game's events: names, optional moments and lengths), or a ready set's events with its library sounds already in use. Names, keys, order and lengths stay the user's; SFXMint writes how each sounds. Without kit_id it starts a new kit for the list. Free (no generation). Then call fill_kit_from_library to use free library sounds first, and make only the gaps.

kit_id.description: Add to this kit (kit_…); leave out to start a new kit.

set.description: Instead of sounds: a ready set's id from get_sound_set (its events, with its library sounds in use).

sounds.description: The sounds, in the user's order.

key.description: The user's own event key or file name, e.g. '01-lab-air' (optional).

name.description: The event, e.g. 'Ride request' or 'Coin pickup'.

scene.description: The scene heading from the user's list or approved proposal (optional); matching existing scene names are reused.

seconds.description: Length in seconds, 0.2 to 10 (optional; rounded to the nearest a kit offers).

name: add_kit_sounds
